title: Discrete Hom and concrete coherent Hom on an ordinary nerve
statement:
Use universes, nerves and weak homotopy equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the simplex-colimit rigidification and singular-realization space category from [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Let $C$ be a $\mathcal V$-small ordinary category. Regard it as the simplicial category $C_{\mathrm{disc}}$ with discrete mapping simplicial sets, and put $B=\mathfrak C[N(C)]$. The augmentation $\epsilon:B\to C_{\mathrm{disc}}$ sends every simplex-string and every subset-path in it to its composite in $C$. For all objects $c,x$, the induced map
$$\operatorname{Sing}|B(c,x)|\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_C(c,x)_{\mathrm{disc}}$$
is a weak homotopy equivalence, natural in $C$ and in precomposition and postcomposition by $B$. Here the target is identified with the singular complex of the realization of a discrete simplicial set. Let $H_C:N(C)^{\mathrm{op}}\times N(C)\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ be the concrete rigidification Hom pairing of [def-coef-infinity-presheaf-yoneda]. The maps induced by $\epsilon$ assemble to a coherent natural equivalence
$$H_C\simeq\big((c,x)\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_C(c,x)_{\mathrm{disc}}\big).$$
It sends the singular identity vertex to the ordinary identity arrow, with its unit homotopy. Thus the strict discrete Hom family, jointly in both variables, is a coherent model of the concrete representable and corepresentable families; this comparison persists under restriction of either variable and inclusion into a containing space universe. Empty Hom sets and the empty category are allowed.

source.place: Construction 8.3.6.1 (03N6) and Proposition 8.3.6.2 (03N7), read online 2026-10-17, specialized to a discrete simplicial category. The explicit comparison with the concrete Sing-realization rigidification family is an agent-formulated counit comparison, not quoted verbatim from 03N7.
